description:
*** EMAIL ENQUIRIES ONLY ***

Due to the considerable level of rental enquiries, please submit your request for tenant application form along with your references or any enquiry you have via email only.  

* No Pets Allowed *

Exceptional 4/5 bedroom, detached home availble To Let in Drumsna Village.

Oak Meadows is a small, well regarded scheme minutes walk from the heart of the village amenities including Drumsna Harbour.

Breifly comprising living room, spacious kitchen/dining room, utility, study/playroom/bedroom 1, ground floor bathroom, first floor landing with large airing cupboard, bedroom & En-suite, 2no. bedrooms with Jack & Jill En-suite, bedroom 5, bathroom.

Externally there is extensive patio & paved area to the rear along with raised garden area, ample parking to the front with larg drive.

The property benefits from oil fired central heating & a solid fuel stove in the living room.
